items.title: The Hollister Collection at Target
items.summary: Hollister is making its debut in the home decor category! Launching June 28th, Hollister has teamed up with Target to create The Hollister Collection, featuring bedding, comforters, sheets and pillows, in addition to apparel across both men’s and women’s categories. items.title: A&F Co. Announces Q1 2026 Earnings Results
items.summary: Today, we announced our Q1 2026 Earnings Results. In Q1, Abercrombie & Fitch Co. delivered record first quarter net sales, marking our 14th consecutive quarter of growth. Driven by continued momentum across the Americas and strong growth in APAC, these results reflect the strength of our brands and the consistent execution of our global teams.

items.title: Hollister Launches Soccer-Inspired Capsule Collection
items.summary: Hollister is kicking off the summer soccer season with the launch of a new capsule collection in partnership with Italian sportswear brand, Kappa. The 22-piece collaboration blends Kappa’s European sport heritage with Hollister’s fashion-first aesthetic, resulting in a collection designed for match days, watch parties and everyday wear. items.title: A&F Co. Announces Q4 and Full Year 2025 Earnings Results
items.summary: Today, we were thrilled to share our Q4 and full-year 2025 financial results, and as a company, we delivered on our goals. We achieved another year of record sales, growth across regions and channels, and double-digit operating margins, with Hollister delivering its best year ever and A&F returning to growth in the fourth quarter.
